sla-active-0240-22-101751.summary: Established authentic Greek taverna in Bronxville (chef Michali Sarris), well-reviewed (#4 of 48 on TripAdvisor). Renewal, not new.
sla-active-0240-22-101751.menu: Gyros, moussaka, grilled meats and seafood, plus catering.
sla-active-0240-22-101751.angle: Allen Brothers lamb and beef for grills/souvlaki, Spiletto olive oil for finishing/marinades, imported feta and cheeses, specialty seafood (branzino/octopus) for a Greek grill program.

sla-active-0340-26-146885.summary: Established Mexican restaurant in downtown White Plains (Chef Tony Tepetitla); the 'Jr.' license ties to the existing Tepe's Kitchen operation.
sla-active-0340-26-146885.menu: Tacos, enchiladas, quesadillas, Mexican breakfast/dinner classics.
sla-active-0340-26-146885.angle: Allen Brothers skirt/flank for fajitas and tacos, specialty seafood for ceviche/tacos, imported cheeses, Grand Reserve butter for the breakfast program.

sla-active-0340-26-146860.summary: New tapas and wine bar opening in downtown New Rochelle at 519 Main St, promoted on IG (@andaluznr) as 'coming soon.' Related to the Cafe Andaluz Spanish tapas concept. New opening.
sla-active-0340-26-146860.angle: Spiletto olive oil for tapas/finishing, imported Spanish/Manchego cheeses, specialty seafood (gambas, octopus, anchovies) for classic tapas, Allen Brothers beef for pintxos/steak tapas.

sla-active-0340-22-103922.summary: The 'Diana' licensee at 454 Old Post Road is Ristorante Lucia (founded 2006, Diana restaurant group), Bedford. Established, not new.
sla-active-0340-22-103922.style: Regional Italian (Frosinone/Tuscan) with a pizzeria side.
sla-active-0340-22-103922.menu: Tuscan/regional Italian; pizzeria side with thin-crust pies and homemade gelato.
sla-active-0340-22-103922.angle: Caputo 00 flour for thin-crust pizza, Teo tomatoes for sauces, Spiletto olive oil, Grand Reserve butter, imported cheeses, Valrhona/Chicoa plus Grand Reserve butter for the house gelato and desserts.

sla-active-0340-22-106755.summary: Palmco Restaurant Corp operates Rosie's Bistro Italiano, an established Italian restaurant at 10 Palmer Ave, Bronxville. Renewal for a long-running, well-reviewed spot.
sla-active-0340-22-106755.menu: Classic Southern Italian: pastas, pizzas, veal, seafood, salads.
sla-active-0340-22-106755.angle: Caputo 00 flour (pizza/pasta), Teo tomatoes for sauces, Spiletto olive oil, imported cheeses, Grand Reserve butter; Allen Brothers beef for veal/steak entrees.

sla-active-0340-23-137953.summary: The Taco Project - established modern Mexican taqueria (small group) at 465 Bedford Rd, Pleasantville. Renewal, not new.
sla-active-0340-23-137953.style: Fast-casual / modern Mexican taqueria with bar.
sla-active-0340-23-137953.menu: Tacos (grilled chicken, Atlantic cod, skirt steak, tempura shrimp), burritos, guacamole, Mexican rice and black beans, brunch, margaritas.
sla-active-0340-23-137953.angle: Specialty seafood (Atlantic cod, shrimp for fish/shrimp tacos), Grand Reserve butter and imported queso fresco; premium beef trim for skirt-steak tacos.

sla-active-0340-22-104980.summary: SLA license under 'Blasi's Pizzeria' at 23 Putnam Ave, Port Chester, but the address operates as Frank's Italian Restaurant & Pizzeria (established Southern Italian/pizza). Likely a renewal under the ownership name.
sla-active-0340-22-104980.menu: Pizza and Southern Italian cuisine, catering, delivery, takeout.
sla-active-0340-22-104980.angle: Caputo 00 flour for dough, Teo tomatoes for sauce, Spiletto olive oil, Grand Reserve butter, imported mozzarella/cheeses; Allen Brothers beef for Italian entrees.

sla-active-0240-26-146647.summary: No public info found for 'United 1217' as an operating restaurant. 1217 Nepperhan Ave, Yonkers currently shows a Taco Bell; 2026 record suggests a new/unrelated licensee with no footprint yet.
sla-active-0240-26-146647.angle: Insufficient info - cold-call to identify concept before proposing products.

sla-active-0240-26-146496.summary: Turkish restaurant at 409 Mt Pleasant Ave, Mamaroneck (formerly Fez/Turkish Meze), now Meze Turkish Cuisine. Family-owned meze/kebabs/grilled fish with an attached Middle Eastern grocery. Recently rebranded.
sla-active-0240-26-146496.style: Family-owned Turkish/Eastern Mediterranean; meze small plates, charcoal grill, attached specialty grocery.
sla-active-0240-26-146496.menu: Cold/hot meze, adana (hand-minced lamb) kebab, shish/doner, baby lamb chops, chicken kebab, char-grilled eggplant, grilled fish, Turkish rice.
sla-active-0240-26-146496.angle: Allen Brothers lamb chops and beef for the mixed-grill kebabs, Spiletto olive oil for meze/dressings, imported cheeses (feta/kasseri) for spreads and borek, Grand Reserve butter for pilaf/pastry.

sla-active-0340-22-107905.summary: El Rinconcito is Rinconcito Salvadoreno, an ESTABLISHED family-owned Salvadoran restaurant at 20 Broad St, Port Chester (since 1993; on Diners, Drive-Ins & Dives 2023). Renewal, not new.
sla-active-0340-22-107905.style: Casual authentic Salvadoran/Central American home cooking; neighborhood institution.
sla-active-0340-22-107905.menu: Handmade pupusas daily, yuca frita, tamales, fresh seafood specialties, traditional Salvadoran plates.
sla-active-0340-22-107905.angle: Tough fit for premium imports, but specialty seafood for their mariscos and Grand Reserve butter for masa/sides; Allen Brothers beef for carne asada plates.

sla-active-0240-26-146443.summary: 24 Woodsbridge Rd, Katonah is Paulie's Deli, a grab-and-go deli (opened Aug 2020; new ownership 2025). Full Boar's Head deli, craft beer cave, patio. Deli, not a full-service kitchen.
sla-active-0240-26-146443.style: Neighborhood grab-and-go deli and craft beer cave; made-to-order sandwiches.
sla-active-0240-26-146443.menu: Made-to-order deli sandwiches and grab-and-go using Boar's Head cold cuts; craft beer.
sla-active-0240-26-146443.angle: Limited fit: imported cheeses to upgrade sandwich builds and Spiletto olive oil for prepared salads/subs; premium beef a stretch for a Boar's Head format.

sla-active-0340-22-108471.summary: Jazz on Main - ESTABLISHED live-music jazz club, bar and restaurant at 37 S Moger Ave, Mount Kisco (opened 2022). Mediterranean menu, craft cocktails, 55-seat room plus stage. Renewal.
sla-active-0340-22-108471.style: Upscale supper-club: live jazz venue with full bar, craft cocktails, Mediterranean-leaning dinner menu.
sla-active-0340-22-108471.menu: Mediterranean small plates and mains plus steaks, craft cocktails; Sunday brunch.
sla-active-0340-22-108471.angle: Strong target: Allen Brothers steaks as centerpiece, Spiletto olive oil and imported cheeses for Mediterranean plates, specialty seafood for appetizers, Valrhona/Chicoa plus Grand Reserve butter for desserts.

sla-active-0340-22-111791.summary: Established seafood-forward New American restaurant in Ossining (Chef Elmer Oliveros); market catches with local produce. Well-reviewed. Renewal.
sla-active-0340-22-111791.style: Upscale-casual New American / seafood, chef-driven, $50+ band.
sla-active-0340-22-111791.menu: Fish & chips, daily fresh catch, seafood dishes with local produce; gluten-free friendly.
sla-active-0340-22-111791.angle: Specialty seafood program plus Grand Reserve butter for pan sauces and Spiletto olive oil for produce-driven plates; Caputo 00 flour and Valrhona for house desserts.

sla-active-0340-26-146150.summary: Established casual bistro/cafe in Port Chester (Hubbard's Cupboard Bistro) known for breakfast/lunch comfort food and quick bites; active IG. Ongoing operation.
sla-active-0340-26-146150.style: Casual bistro / cafe; comfort food, breakfast and lunch.
sla-active-0340-26-146150.menu: Comfort food, quick bites, coffee, breakfast and lunch fare.
sla-active-0340-26-146150.angle: Grand Reserve butter and Caputo 00 flour for scratch bakery/breakfast, imported cheeses for sandwiches, Valrhona/Chicoa for pastries.

sla-active-0340-22-106230.summary: Main St Steakery Inc (incorporated 1986) shares 700 Main St, New Rochelle with Juliano's Caterers - a long-standing steakhouse/catering operation. Renewal; no consumer-facing menu found.
sla-active-0340-22-106230.angle: Anchor on Allen Brothers premium beef for the steak/banquet program, Grand Reserve butter for finishing, Teo tomatoes and Caputo 00 flour for Italian-catering sides.

sla-active-0340-24-122872.summary: Established American gastropub, Our Place Kitchen & Bar, Yorktown Heights. Own site, active socials, full bar, event room, patio. Existing operation, not new.
sla-active-0340-24-122872.style: American gastropub / kitchen & bar; upscale-casual, full bar, patio.
sla-active-0340-24-122872.menu: American fare: brie-stuffed pretzel, wings, tacos, cowboy fried chicken, corn dip, warm Brussels salad; veg/GF friendly.
sla-active-0340-24-122872.angle: Allen Brothers beef for burgers/steaks, Grand Reserve butter and imported cheeses for shareables (brie pretzel, corn dip), Spiletto olive oil for salads, Valrhona for desserts.
